id.description: Stable snake_case identifier, unique within its collection. Becomes the UE DataTable row name.

step_id.description: A mission step id, or one of the terminal ids: end / success (mission completed), fail (mission failed). The runtime and tools/validate.py accept exactly these.

ref.description: Reference to another record as '<collection>:<id>', checked by tools/validate.py.

text.description: Localised text. Vietnamese is the source language.

geo.description: WGS84 point. Converted to engine coordinates through the city manifest's georeference.

hour_range.description: Hours of day [from, to), 0-24; to < from wraps past midnight.

condition.description: Gate evaluated by the runtime (UHanoiMissionSubsystem::EvaluateCondition). All listed fields must hold: flags all set, not_flags none set, events_active all currently active (SetWorldEventActive).

not_flags.description: None of these flags may be set.

events_active.description: World events (collection events) that must currently be active.

min_skills.description: Skill id (characters/*.json skills, skills.json) -> minimum level 0-100 the current protagonist must have. Levels used as gates must be a tier level in skills.json so the unlock is visible (tests/test_skill_unlocks.py).
